What we're looking for - A CE license, a valid Code 95 qualification and a tachograph driver card. - Experience as a truck driver is a plus. - Able to work independently and responsibly. - Customer-focused, with a professional appearance. - Good command of Dutch. - Flexible and reliable. What we offer - A varied role in a stable and growing organization. - Modern trucks and well-maintained equipment. - Pay under the Dutch collective bargaining agreement for road freight transport (cao Beroepsgoederenvervoer). - Good employment terms and a pension plan. ...
